A DVR diagram giving two lifts would have generic image in Spec K and closed image in the two distinct closed points, forcing a local injective V→DVR. But the image of t would have positive integer valuation divisible by every n via t^{1/n}, impossible. A V-valuative diagram uses the two chart inclusions. Field valuation rings are allowed in the full criterion but are not DVRs under the published convention; their sole point is fixed by the specified generic map. The DVR-only uniqueness statement and failure of all-valuation uniqueness remain separate.
